findings.highlight: Shinji is holding Sakura hostage
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二が桜を連れている以上
findings.governingReading: Rin says only that Shinji has Sakura with him, which prevents her lending aid freely.
findings.explanation: A conditional English variant explicitly labels Sakura a hostage before the source does.

findings.highlight: I’ll be hiding
findings.evidenceJa: 出来るだけ近くで身を隠している
findings.governingReading: Rin will conceal herself as close as she possibly can.
findings.explanation: The English omits the proximity essential to Rin’s rescue plan.

findings.highlight: That convinces me
findings.evidenceJa: 怒りに走っていた心に覚悟が入った
findings.governingReading: Resolve enters and steadies Shirou’s anger-driven heart.
findings.explanation: The English reduces an internal shift from rage to committed resolve into mere persuasion.

findings.highlight: I’m going to get Sakura back
findings.evidenceJa: 必ず桜を無傷で取り返す
findings.governingReading: Shirou commits to retrieving Sakura completely unharmed.
findings.explanation: The English deletes the crucial condition that Sakura suffer no injury.

findings.highlight: under the condition that you’re still alive to protect Sakura
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方がちゃんと無事で、きちんと桜を守ってあげてるって条件付き
findings.governingReading: Rin’s help is conditional on Shirou himself remaining safely intact and properly protecting Sakura.
findings.explanation: “Still alive” weakens his own safety and compresses two concurrent requirements into purpose.

findings.highlight: the school closed early
findings.evidenceJa: 下校時刻を早めた
findings.governingReading: The coma incidents caused the time at which students were sent home to be moved earlier.
findings.explanation: The English makes the institution close rather than describing early dismissal.

findings.highlight: my only weapon
findings.evidenceJa: ただ一つの“[ruby text=ぶき o2o=1]強化”
findings.governingReading: Shirou calls Strengthening his sole permitted technique while the ruby explicitly reads it as his weapon.
findings.explanation: The English keeps only the ruby gloss and deletes the named magecraft technique.

findings.highlight: Shinji, holding a knife at Sakura
findings.evidenceJa: 桜を脇に従えている慎二がいた。その手に握られたナイフの切先は、桜に向けられている
findings.governingReading: Shinji has Sakura beside him and points the knife in his hand toward her.
findings.explanation: The variant collapses two spatial facts into malformed English that can imply Sakura herself is the object being held.

findings.highlight: My feet start to move again
findings.evidenceJa: 止まっていた足が再び地を蹴る
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s arrested feet kick off the ground again.
findings.explanation: The English removes the explosive propulsion that carries him toward Sakura.

findings.highlight: I slide to an abrupt halt
findings.evidenceJa: 前に出ようとする体を押しとどめる
findings.governingReading: Shirou forcibly checks his body as it tries to surge forward.
findings.explanation: The English invents a sliding stop and loses his struggle against his own forward impulse.

findings.highlight: My head shakes so much that I almost forget about the Servant
findings.evidenceJa: ライダーが目に入らないぐらい、頭がクラクラしている
findings.governingReading: Shirou is so dizzy with white-hot anger that Rider no longer even registers in his vision.
findings.explanation: The English changes failed visual awareness into nearly forgetting her and makes his head physically shake.

findings.highlight: So why doesn’t he understand?
findings.evidenceJa: なのにどうしてこんなことに
findings.governingReading: Shirou asks how their sibling relationship could possibly have come to this.
findings.explanation: The English changes horror at the situation into a question about Shinji’s comprehension.

findings.highlight: how Sakura must feel to have her own brother holding a knife to her
findings.evidenceJa: 妹の気持ちが、どうして
findings.governingReading: The line centers Sakura’s feelings toward such a brother without specifying a fresh knife action.
findings.explanation: A conditional English variant inserts explicit knife restraint into the sentence.

findings.highlight: using the last trump card
findings.evidenceJa: 本気だからここで待っていた
findings.governingReading: Shinji says his seriousness is why he waited there.
findings.explanation: The English variant invents a “last trump card.”

findings.highlight: Why are you stupid
findings.evidenceJa: なに寝ぼけてんだよ
findings.governingReading: Shinji asks what Shirou is still half-asleep or deluded about at this late stage.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the situational taunt with a flat judgment of intelligence.

findings.highlight: Before I know it, I’m running
findings.evidenceJa: 体が前に出る
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s body pitches forward under the urge to run to Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English makes him already run, disrupting the next page where Rider still bars his way.

findings.highlight: pull myself together
findings.evidenceJa: 乗り出した体を下げる
findings.governingReading: After breathing deeply, Shirou lowers the body he had thrust forward.
findings.explanation: The English removes the physical repositioning and substitutes mental composure.

findings.highlight: She’s not unconscious
findings.evidenceJa: 気を失っている
findings.governingReading: Shirou judges that she is probably not unconscious because she stands on her own feet.
findings.explanation: The English promotes his inference into certainty.

findings.highlight: because she doesn’t want to raise it
findings.evidenceJa: 顔をあげる事ができないから
findings.governingReading: Sakura keeps her head down because she cannot bring herself to raise her face.
findings.explanation: The English changes constrained inability born of shame into preference or refusal.

findings.highlight: about us
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=オレたち o2o=1]聖杯戦争の事
findings.governingReading: Shirou asks whether Shinji told Sakura about the Holy Grail War, written with “us” as its ruby reading.
findings.explanation: The English keeps only the pronoun-like ruby and deletes the named war.

findings.highlight: He presses the blade against Sakura’s cheek
findings.evidenceJa: 桜は顔を背け、それでも顔を上げることはできないと
findings.governingReading: The Japanese begins directly with Sakura turning her face away and desperately keeping it lowered.
findings.explanation: The English inserts Shinji pressing the knife blade against Sakura’s cheek.

findings.highlight: get on my knees and beg
findings.evidenceJa: ここで土下座でもしろっていうのか
findings.governingReading: Shirou asks whether Shinji wants formal prostration on the spot.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the culturally and physically specific dogeza with kneeling and adds begging.

findings.highlight: Heh
findings.evidenceJa: 言ってくれる
findings.governingReading: Shirou reacts bitterly to the outrageous demand: Shinji has some nerve saying it.
findings.explanation: The English reduces the response to an ambiguous little laugh.

findings.highlight: I’ll have her break your limbs
findings.evidenceJa: 二、三本は折らせてもらう
findings.governingReading: Shinji says he will have Rider break two or three bones.
findings.explanation: The English expands a counted number of broken bones into the broader destruction of Shirou’s limbs.

findings.highlight: I’ll have Sakura take the rest
findings.evidenceJa: 桜は僕が連れて帰ることになる
findings.governingReading: Shinji threatens to take Sakura home if Shirou loses consciousness too early.
findings.explanation: A conditional English variant replaces the abduction threat with a sexualized implication that Sakura will receive the remaining beating.

findings.highlight: impact that almost blows the bones away with it
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=かた o2o=1]根元から骨ごと吹き飛ばしそうな衝撃
findings.governingReading: The impact seems capable of blowing Shirou’s arm off, bone and all, from its root at the shoulder.
findings.explanation: The English omits the arm’s shoulder-root and leaves an unclear image of bones being blown away.

findings.highlight: I lace my senses as fast as possible
findings.evidenceJa: 全速で意識を編み上げる
findings.governingReading: Shirou weaves his consciousness together at full speed to initiate magecraft.
findings.explanation: The English changes the magecraft-related act from constructing consciousness to lacing sensory perception.

findings.highlight: turn my body into something even stronger
findings.evidenceJa: 無防備な体を少しでも硬く
findings.governingReading: Shirou must make his defenseless body even slightly harder.
findings.explanation: The English changes desperate marginal reinforcement into an unspecified stronger transformation.

findings.highlight: blow like a bushhammer
findings.evidenceJa: 玄翁じみた一撃
findings.governingReading: The blow is like a genno, a heavy Japanese hammer or sledgehammer.
findings.explanation: “Bushhammer” denotes a toothed masonry tool and gives the wrong impact image.

findings.highlight: If she takes another shot at my head
findings.evidenceJa: 顔を狙われたら
findings.governingReading: Shirou fears an attack specifically aimed at his face.
findings.explanation: The English broadens the vulnerable target from face to head.

findings.highlight: She beats me relentlessly, just as Shinji ordered
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二の命令通り、一切の無駄なく拳を繰り出してくる
findings.governingReading: Rider throws each fist exactly under Shinji’s order with no wasted motion whatsoever.
findings.explanation: The English keeps relentlessness but deletes the machine-like economy that motivates the following comparison.

findings.highlight: What is Rider thinking?
findings.evidenceJa: それを、ライダーはどう取ったのか
findings.governingReading: Shirou wonders how Rider interpreted his decision to guard only his face.
findings.explanation: The English changes her reading of his tactic into a generic question about her thoughts.

findings.highlight: tear me in half
findings.evidenceJa: 胃袋ぐらい破裂させる
findings.governingReading: Rider’s earlier strength could rupture Shirou’s stomach with one blow.
findings.explanation: The English replaces a specific internal injury with tearing his entire body in half.

findings.highlight: The bruises from last night
findings.evidenceJa: 治りきっていない昨夜の腹の傷
findings.governingReading: The still-unhealed wound in Shirou’s abdomen from the previous night screams in pain.
findings.explanation: The English changes a continuing serious wound into bruises.

findings.highlight: Gastric juice fills my mouth
findings.evidenceJa: 胃液が口まで逆流して
findings.governingReading: Gastric fluid refluxes all the way up to Shirou’s mouth.
findings.explanation: The English removes the upward internal motion and says only that his mouth fills.

findings.highlight: You’re in front of Sakura, so take it like a man
findings.evidenceJa: 桜の前なんだからしっかりしろよ。そんなんじゃぜんぜん格好つかない
findings.governingReading: Shinji tells Shirou to hold himself together before Sakura or he will not look impressive at all.
findings.explanation: The English inserts a gendered command to endure the beating “like a man.”

findings.highlight: steps back and watches
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の倒壊を見届けようとする
findings.governingReading: Rider draws back slightly to watch Shirou’s collapse through to completion.
findings.explanation: The English omits what she is specifically waiting to witness.

findings.highlight: I’m bruised everywhere I got hit
findings.evidenceJa: 痣になって血流を濁らせ
findings.governingReading: The struck places have become bruises that obstruct or muddy Shirou’s blood flow.
findings.explanation: The English omits the circulatory consequence of the bruising.

findings.highlight: This isn’t part of Shinji’s plan
findings.evidenceJa: これは慎二の意思じゃない
findings.governingReading: Shirou realizes Rider’s restraint does not express Shinji’s will; it is Rider’s own choice.
findings.explanation: The English frames the issue as plan membership rather than the agency governing Rider’s blows.

findings.highlight: hits me in the chest
findings.evidenceJa: この胸を突き上げた
findings.governingReading: Rider drives a vastly stronger blow upward into Shirou’s chest.
findings.explanation: The English omits the strike’s upward trajectory.

findings.highlight: a scream and a delighted laugh
findings.evidenceJa: くぐもった悲鳴と歓喜の声
findings.governingReading: Shirou hears a muffled scream and a voice of jubilation while airborne.
findings.explanation: The English removes the muffling and turns the joyful voice into laughter.

findings.highlight: is close
findings.evidenceJa: 今までよりずっと近い
findings.governingReading: Sakura’s voice is much closer than it has been until now, confirming the positional maneuver.
findings.explanation: The English deletes the comparison that signals Shirou has closed the planned distance.

findings.highlight: hit the floor and died
findings.evidenceJa: 背中から落ちて死ぬ
findings.governingReading: Ordinarily Shirou would fall onto his back and die.
findings.explanation: The English omits the back-first landing central to the aerial rotation that follows.

findings.highlight: Now
findings.evidenceJa: せーの
findings.governingReading: Shirou gives himself a rhythmic “one, two” or “heave-ho” cue as he executes the timed reversal.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the physical timing cue with a generic command.

findings.highlight: I don’t care about it digging into my hand because it’s numb
findings.evidenceJa: 麻痺していたおかげで気にならない
findings.governingReading: Because the hand is numb, the sensation of the blade biting deeply into flesh does not register as a concern.
findings.explanation: The English makes Shirou consciously indifferent to the wound rather than unable to feel its urgency.
